TeamLogoBitmapsEnd_2: Draws a logo box at x=8 from the value at $1939A.
PrintRecordTitlesSub1: Prints the record titles with ThreeStars data.
ShootersSelectSub1: Clears the shooter screen and draws its backdrop.

seta2Sub1: Stores the menu handler pointers and clears the cursor.
PutTeamBlockSub1: Draws a team block with display flags set.
UpdateScoresScroll_1: Sets up the VDP DMA write for the scores scroll.

UpdateStatsListScroll_2: Draws the first visible stats row.
UpdateStatsListScroll_3: Draws the stats row six lines below the first.
GetPlayerCountSub1: Reads joypad 2 or 1 depending on the port flag.
check4check_1: Returns unless the player has a checker set at $34.
forceblack2Sub1: Saves the VBint and flags and installs the fade handler.
setVramSub1: Sets the VDP VRAM write command from d0.
NewTickerSub2: Takes the next queued ticker message.
SetTickerAreaPositionSub2: Skips d0 offset-linked entries starting at a1.
RemovePlayerFromList_1: Shifts the byte list down by one entry.
checkint_1: Runs the check for both a3 and a2.
CopyTeamBlockMapDataSub1: Fills the four map entries from the table at $3EE08.

GameSetUpSub4: Jumps to the disc routine at $40132.
SetFrameRectUnused_1: Prints a title in font 1 and adjusts printy.
PrintOptionNamesSub1: Installs the options-screen vblank handler and display flags.

DrawLineIconSub1: Erases the line icon area after printing.
ReadStatColumnSub1: Selects the stat column table and indexes it.
CrowdMeterScreenSub1: Forces black and sets display flags for the crowd meter screen.
adda42_1: Advances the replay pointer by $62 and wraps at the end of the buffer.
RestoreReplayFrame_1: Copies the saved replay sprite state back.
faceoffinputExitSub1: Leaves faceoff input when the player is locked.
setlccordsSub1: Picks the line-change coordinates for the current side.
lineinputSub1: Stores the choice and sets its coordinates.
passtoSub1: Jumps to the pass routine at $2B4E2.
shotdiradjSub1: Checks the direction bits before adjusting a shot.
chkpk2Sub1: Checks the puck holder and waits for DMA.
assexitSub1: Pushes a player on the assist ring buffer ($36 index).
GetHotSub1: Counts the hot entries of a record.
DoDMAproSub1: Queues a DMA command in the list at $19360.
DoDMA_nd2Sub1: Queues a DMA command in the list at $19360.
DecompressGraphicsPlain_1: Queues the decompress command in the list at $19360.
PushNumberWidthSub1: Appends the number string, then returns through a1.
AddSmallFontSub1: Loads the small font from the framer map.
AddSmallFontSub2: Loads the small font from the second map.
NewTickerSub1: Skips when the ticker timer is above $1E0.
NewTicker3Sub1: Sets the ticker position and erases it.
SetTickerAreaPositionSub1: Skips to the entry and prints it small.
setplayerSub1: Chooses the team structure for the player.
setupIceRinkPalSub1: Decompresses the rink palette with remap.
SprSortSub1: Sets up the sprite sort buffers.
CopyTeamLinesSub1: Checks teams for the special team number $13.
GameOverSub2: Resets scroll state and clears the display request.

InitializeGameStructuresSub1: Builds the mask of the two playing teams.
ShowGoalBoxSub1: Draws the goal box after the flag checks.
GetPlayerNameSub1: Builds the name text in the message area.
